snippet.title: LEGACY EP 07 | THE HEAT IS ON | @raftaarmusic x @KRSNAOfficial
snippet.description:
Chapter 2 continues, and the heat is on.

The artists step into the LEGACY Arena, where the audience is watching, the competition is getting tougher and every performance is a chance to prove they belong.

They’ve earned their way this far, but in the Arena, with a live audience and special guests weighing every bar, they must prove what they’ve got in real time.

Who will rise to the occasion, and who will struggle to handle the heat?

5:41 KNSS
12:39 Chief
21:45 Khushi
33:27 Vishi

snippet.title: RAMAYANA - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
The Ramayana Trailer.
This is where the EPIC BEGINS. 🏹 

Namit Malhotra's Ramayana
Directed by Nitesh Tiwari

In Cinemas Worldwide, Diwali 2026.

---------------------------------------------------

Starring: 
Ranbir Kapoor as Rama 
Yash as Ravana 
Sai Pallavi as Sita 
Ravie Dubey as Lakshman 
Sunny Deol as Hanuman

Co-Produced by Monster Mind Creations
Adapted for Screenplay by Shridhar Raghavan & Nitesh Tiwari
Music by Hans Zimmer & A.R. Rahman
Lyrics by Kumar Vishwas


Music Supervisor & Editor - Hiral Viradia & A.R. Ameen 
Solo Violin- Rangapriya 
Shloka Sung by Rakshita Suresh
Sitar by Rishab Rikhiram Sharma

Extended Credits:
Chorus Conducted by Arjun Chandy 
Chorus- Mahalingam, Vaishali Samant, Vipin Aneja, Deepthi Suresh, Sarath Santosh, Aravind Srinivasan, Aparna Harikumar 
Music Mixed by Suresh Permal 
Additional Programming - Prashanth Venkat, Shubham Bhat & Sidharth Narayanan

Presented by Prime Focus Studios in association with Monster Mind Creations

Global Distribution by Sony Pictures Entertainment
Music by T-Series

VFX by DNEG (8-time Academy Award winner)
Filmed for IMAX

snippet.title: Sardar 2 Teaser | Karthi | SJ Suryah | Malavika Mohanan | Ashika Ranganath | PS Mithran | Sam CS
snippet.description:
Here is the teaser of "Sardar 2" Starring Karthi and Directed by PS Mithran. 

Produced by Prince Pictures and Ivy Entertainment. 

Starring - Karthi, SJ Suryah, Malavika Mohanan, Ashika Ranganath, Yogi Babu, Rajisha Vijayan and others. 
Directed - by P.S Mithran 
Based on Story & Characters by  P.S Mithran
Co Produced by - A. Venkatesh 
Produced by - S. Lakshman Kumar and Ishan Saksena

Music - Sam CS
DOP - George C Williams 
Editor - Vijay Velukutty
Production Design - Rajeevan Nambiar
Production Executive - AP Paalpaandi 
Art - MSP Madhavan, B. Sekar
Stunt - Dhilip Subbarayan, Chethan D'souza
Sound Design - Tapas Nayak
Writers - Rathna Kumar, Aashameera Aiyappan, Vignesh Muniyandi
Screenplay - Nambi
Additional Story - Rathna Kumar, Ashameera Aiyappan, Vignesh Muniyandi 
Production Manager - A sathik, S Nagarajan, K Vijay 
Co Directors:- Ashok kumar, Naveen Nanjundan
Costume Designer - Poornima Ramaswamy 
Makeup - Nellai V Shanmugam
Special Makeup - Pattanam Rasheed
Casting - Varsha Varadarajan
Colorist - Prasath Somasekar 
DI - Knack Studios
VFX - Mind Stein Studios, Dheera Studios
Production Manager - A. Sathik
Stills - Mahesh Jayachandran 
PRO - Sathish (S2 Media) 
Promotions - Cinemapayyan
Publicity Design - NXTGEN Shynumash
Teaser Edit - Vijay Velukutty

Music credits 
Music : Sam CS 
Singer : Antony Dasan, Imbachi ,Zeba Tommy, Lavita Lobo, Sam C S
Lyrics :Nambi, Lavita Lobo, Imbachi, Zeba Tommy 
Music Producer : Sathish Surrender 
Live Strings and Brass : Chennai Orchestra
Indian Live Rhythm : Raju, Lakshmikanth, Pyare Lal
Electric Guitar : Supervijay
Whistle : Sam C S 
Recorded at Psalter Record Inn Pvt Ltd. Chennai. 
Engineered by Chidambara Kannan M and Sam Joshi PS 
Mixed and Mastered by Avinash Sathish at Jovi Records
Production Manager : Mahima Choudhary, Kannan
Music Co-ordinator : Velavan B 
Tech Support : Parthiban at The Pro Audio

Lyrics

Tamil:
படை திடம் படையாளியாகும் 
ஆழியாகும் வீரா வீரா..

உறுமிடும் ஒரு யாளி ஆகும் 
யாளி ஆகும் சூரா தீரா…

VERSE - 

I need to set it straight, 
Never gonna settle,
I’m bringing the venom
When I’d be there villainous,
Gotta be killing ‘em,
Never benevolent,
About to go win it,
They call me the thalavan,
Chopping their heads
And I’m making it mine,
When I’m raking the truth 
I’m serving you the light,
Nobody stopping it,
Taking ‘em on
I’m ready for the fight

I said I came, and I saw, I’m riding into the night 

let the people hear of my kindgdom come 
yeah they breaking me tearing me see me fall below
let the bloodstains fall watch it all burn down 
cant touch me, but you can see me
paint their walls red dipped in the blood of my foes 
its a fever im a dreamer watch me make it all go
OUTRO - 

You thought that I’m gonna be done but you know I’m coming back, 
Taking back the throne right at dawn

snippet.description:
Why Is Everyone Hating the Ramayana Trailer? 🚨 | CINIMAWOOD Deep Dive

Nitesh Tiwari’s massive ₹4,000 Crore magnum opus 'RAMAYANA: Part 1' (starring Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, and Sai Pallavi) just dropped its official trailer—and social media has instantly split down the middle! 

While many fans are praising Yash’s dark, commanding aura as Ravana and the scale built by DNEG’s visual effects, a huge section of the internet is calling out the trailer for major flaws. Is the hate actually justified, or are audiences just hard to satisfy after Adipurush? 

In this video, CINIMAWOOD breaks down:
1️⃣ Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Ram – Perfect casting or major misfit?
2️⃣ The VFX & CGI Controversy – Why certain shots feel like a video game.
3️⃣ The Missing Hanuman Controversy – Where is Sunny Deol in the trailer?
4️⃣ Yash’s Hindi Voice Dubbing – Did the dialogue impact get lost in translation?
5️⃣ Westernized Aesthetics – Why critics say Ravana’s kingdom looks like Lord of the Rings.

💬 WHAT IS YOUR TAKE? 
Did you love the Ramayana trailer, or did it leave you disappointed? Drop your honest thoughts in the comments below!

ইতিহাস এবার ফিরছে বড় পর্দায়।
স্বাধীনতার ইতিহাসের এক অনন্য অধ্যায় - অনন্ত সিংহ
যে নাম আইনের পাতায় বিতর্কিত, কিন্তু সাহসের ইতিহাসে চিরস্মরণীয়

The Official Trailer of "Keu Bole Biplobi Keu Bole Dakat" is OUT NOW.

Witness the extraordinary journey of legendary revolutionary Ananta Singh- a story of courage, sacrifice, resilience, and an unyielding fight for freedom. Brought to life by Superstar Jeet, this is a cinematic tribute to one of India's most fearless revolutionaries.

Witness Superstar JEET in one of his most powerful transformations yet in "কেউ বলে বিপ্লবী কেউ বলে ডাকাত" (Keu Bole Biplobi, Keu Bole Dakat). Inspired by the extraordinary life of legendary revolutionary Ananta Singh, the film is a stirring tribute to courage, sacrifice, and the relentless pursuit of freedom. An epic cinematic experience awaits.

Director: Pathikrrit Basu
Producers: Nandy Movies and Jeetz Filmworks Pvt. Ltd.
Pradip Kumar Nandy

Releasing on 14th August in your nearest theatres!

______________________
Starring:
Superstar Jeet | Tota Roychowdhury | Loknath Dey | Chandan Sen | Priyanka Sarkar | Debasmita | Debopriyo | Durbar Sharma | Jammy Banerjee | Subhrojit and other amazing actors

Story Development & Screenplay  : Aritra Banerjee & Arpan Gupta
Editor: Moloy Laha
Production Controller : Bhola Choudhary
Dialogue: Soumit Deb, Arpan Gupta & Aritra Banerjee
Music & Background Score: Shantanu Moitra
Cinematography: Soumik Halder (I S C)
Action Director: Stun Siva
Art Direction: Tanmay Chakraborty
Make up : Somnath Kundu
Costume : Sanchita Pal Chakraborty
Sound Design & Mixing: Anindit Ray & Adeep Singh Manki
Color Grading: Ritajit Raychaudhuri
Teaser and Motion Graphics : M7 Media
VFX:  Raj VFX Private Limited
Publicity Design : Join the Dots
Subtitle : Sudeshna Roy
Assistant Director Team : Dipankar Sarkar (Chief), Paawan Aagarwal (Associate), Ayan Poddar, Tanima Ghosh, Antariskh Ray, Biplab Bhaumik, Debayan Saha, Bishambar Das

Edit Studio : Grassroot Entertainment

Jeet’s Team : Abhishek Ghosh, Manjit Tiwari, Krishna  Bahadur Bhandari, Somnath Kar, David Gurung, Dhananjay Singh, Anindya Goswami, Sourav Singh

Jeetz Filmworks Team : Abhijit Bhattacharjee, Debashis Mallick, Lalit Mitra, Prodyut Roy,Somnath Saha, Amrik Karmakar, Abhijit Purkait, Priti Saha, Dilip Giri, Pritha Karmakar, Sumit Shaw, Ranjit Naskar

Nandy Movies Team :  Tumpa Nandy (Associate Producer), Amit Das (Executive Producer), Debalina Samanta (Creative Producer), Sruti Bose (Marketing), Sayani Chakraborty (Public Relation), Sanjib Dey (IT Support)

.
.
.

snippet.title: Violent Night 2 | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Merry Christmas to all, and to all a good fight. Violent Night 2 only in theaters December 4.

If you’re nice, you get presents from the Big Guy. If you’re naughty, you get justice. 

David Harbour reprises his role as Santa Claus in a propulsive new chapter in yuletide mayhem from 87North—the powerhouse producers of Bullet Train, John Wick, The Fall Guy, Atomic Blonde and the Nobody franchise—and returning action director Tommy Wirkola. 

In 2022’s bare-knuckle holiday sensation, Violent Night, an embittered Santa, armed with lethal combat skills, took out a team of mercenaries to rescue a girl and her family. Now, not-so-jolly Saint Nick suits up again to take on a ruthless gangster (Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Jared Harris) terrorizing the merchants of the Silver Bell Mall. 

But when Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he’ll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus (Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Kristen Bell).  

Along with David Harbour, Jared Harris and Kristen Bell, the dynamic cast includes Emmy winning screen legend Joe Pantoliano (The Last of Us, The Sopranos), Daniela Melchior (Fast X, Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3), Andrew Bachelor (Greenland, The Walking Dead), and AEW professional wrestler Maxwell Friedman (The Iron Claw, Happy Gilmore 2). 

Violent Night 2 is directed by returning filmmaker Tommy Wirkola and produced again by 87North founders Kelly McCormick and David Leitch. The film’s returning screenwriters are Pat Casey and Josh Miller. Violent Night 2 will be released by Universal Pictures.

🎬 Poovoma Oorgolam – Chinna Thambi (1991) 4K 60FPS Video Song | S. P. Balasubrahmanyam | Swarnalatha | Ilaiyaraaja

📝 YouTube Description

🎶 Poovoma Oorgolam is one of the most beloved Tamil romantic melodies from the blockbuster movie **Chinna Thambi (1991)**.

🎤 Beautifully sung by the legendary **S. P. Balasubrahmanyam** and **Swarnalatha**, this evergreen duet is cherished for its soulful vocals, heartwarming romance, and timeless charm.

🎼 Music composed by **Isaignani Ilaiyaraaja** delivers a mesmerizing melody that has remained a favorite among Tamil music lovers for generations.

✍️ Lyrics written by **Gangai Amaran** beautifully express love, dreams, and the joy of togetherness through poetic and memorable verses.

🎬 Featured in **Chinna Thambi (1991)**, starring **Prabhu** and **Khushbu**, this iconic melody continues to be one of the greatest romantic songs in Tamil cinema.

✨ Experience this timeless Tamil classic in stunning **4K 60FPS HD** quality with enhanced visuals and smooth playback.

Lyrics:
பாடகி : ஸ்வர்ணலதா

பாடகர் : எஸ்.பி. பாலசுப்ரமணியம்

இசையமைப்பாளர் : இளையராஜா

விஷ்லிங் : .....................

பெண் : போவோமா
ஊர்கோலம் பூலோகம்
எங்கெங்கும் ஓடும்
பொன்னி ஆறும் பாடும்
கானம் நூறும் காலம்
யாவும் பேரின்பம் காணும்
நேரம் ஆனந்தம் போவோமா
ஊர்கோலம் பூலோகம்
எங்கெங்கும்

ஆண் : அரண்மனை
அன்னக்கிளி தரையில
நடப்பது நடக்குமா
அடுக்குமா

பெண் : பனியிலும்
வெட்டவெளி வெயிலிலும்
உள்ள சுகம் அரண்மனை
கொடுக்குமா

ஆண் : குளுகுளு
அறையில கொஞ்சிக்
கொஞ்சி தவழ்ந்தது
குடிசைய விரும்புமா

பெண் : சிலுசிலு
சிலுவென இங்கிருக்கும்
காத்து அங்க அடிக்குமா
கிடைக்குமா

ஆண் : பளிங்கு போல
உன் வீடு வழியில
பள்ளம் மேடு

பெண் : வரப்பு மேடு
வயலோடும் பறந்து
போவேன் பாரு

ஆண் : அதிசயமான
பெண்தானே

பெண் : புதுசுகம்
தேடி வந்தேனே

ஆண் : போவோமா
ஊர்கோலம் பூலோகம்
எங்கெங்கும் ஓடும்
பொன்னி ஆறும் பாடும்
கானம் நூறும் காலம்
யாவும் பேரின்பம் காணும்
நேரம் ஆனந்தம் போவோமா
ஊர்கோலம் பூலோகம்
எங்கெங்கும்

பெண் : கொட்டுகிற
அருவியும் மெட்டுக்கட்டும்
குருவியும் அடடடா அதிசயம்

ஆண் : கற்பனையில்
மிதக்குது கண்டதையும்
ரசிக்குது இதிலென்ன
ஒரு சுகம்

பெண் : ரத்தினங்கள்
தெறிக்குது முத்துமணி
ஜொலிக்குது நடந்திடும்
நதியிலே

ஆண் : உச்சந்தல
சொழலுது உள்ளுக்குள்ள
மயங்குது எனக்கொன்னும்
புரியல

பெண் : கவிதை பாடும்
காவேரி ஜதிய சேர்த்து
ஆடும்

ஆண் : அணைகள் நூறு
போட்டாலும் அடங்கிடாமல்
ஓடும்

பெண் : போதும் போதும்
உம் பாட்டு

ஆண் : பொறப்படப்
போறேன் நிப்பாட்டு

பெண் : போவோமா ஊர்கோலம்
பூலோகம் எங்கெங்கும்

ஆண் : ஓடும் பொன்னி
ஆறும் பாடும் கானம்
நூறும்

பெண் : காலம் யாவும்
பேரின்பம் காணும் நேரம்
ஆனந்தம்

ஆண் : போவோமா
ஊர்கோலம்

பெண் : பூலோகம்
எங்கெங்கும்

Just when Franklin starts realizing his incredible new powers, Joker arrives with his gang to attack his family and kidnap Shiranui. Franklin fights back using his amazing spider abilities and becomes the city's newest superhero!

Thanos launches a deadly attack on Iron Man, forcing Franklin to swing across the city for the biggest battle of his life. Meanwhile, Thanos' son turns Pinchan into the terrifying Venom! Can Franklin save Iron Man, rescue Pinchan, and stop Thanos before it's too late?

snippet.title: Shiv Tandav Stotram | शिव तांडव स्तोत्रम | Sawan Shiv Bhajan | Sawan Song | Sawan Bhajan
snippet.description:
Feel the supreme cosmic vibrations of Lord Shiva this holy Sawan Maas with the powerful recitation of the Shiv Tandav Stotram. Beginning your morning with this energetic prayer removes all obstacles, destroys negative energies, and fills your surroundings with unmatched strength, courage, and positive energy.

The Shiv Tandav Stotram is a magnificent ancient hymn composed by King Ravana, the great devotee of Mahadev. It vividly describes the intense, glorious cosmic dance (Tandava) of Lord Shiva. Each verse captures the majestic attributes of Shiva—his matted hair holding the roaring Ganga, the fierce fire on his forehead, the rhythmic beat of his damru, and the crescent moon adorning his head. It is a profound praise of Shiva as the master of time, power, and transformation.

Chanting or listening to these powerful Hindi verses during the auspicious month of Sawan creates an impenetrable protective shield around your mind and family. The precise acoustic rhythm cleanses your inner thoughts, alleviates stress, and instills a deep sense of confidence and spiritual clarity. For anyone seeking career growth, emotional healing, or freedom from fear, surrendering to the dynamic energy of Mahadev brings absolute success.

The ideal time to listen to this high-energy Sawan Song is during the early morning hours or during evening twilight prayers. Let the sacred rhythms elevate your spirit and deepen your devotion.

Har Har Mahadev!

Singer :- Shankar Mahadevan
Music :- Shailesh Dani

en.description:
Feel the supreme cosmic vibrations of Lord Shiva this holy Sawan Maas with the powerful recitation of the Shiv Tandav Stotram. Beginning your morning with this energetic prayer removes all obstacles, destroys negative energies, and fills your surroundings with unmatched strength, courage, and positive energy.

The Shiv Tandav Stotram is a magnificent ancient hymn composed by King Ravana, the great devotee of Mahadev. It vividly describes the intense, glorious cosmic dance (Tandava) of Lord Shiva. Each verse captures the majestic attributes of Shiva—his matted hair holding the roaring Ganga, the fierce fire on his forehead, the rhythmic beat of his damru, and the crescent moon adorning his head. It is a profound praise of Shiva as the master of time, power, and transformation.

Chanting or listening to these powerful Hindi verses during the auspicious month of Sawan creates an impenetrable protective shield around your mind and family. The precise acoustic rhythm cleanses your inner thoughts, alleviates stress, and instills a deep sense of confidence and spiritual clarity. For anyone seeking career growth, emotional healing, or freedom from fear, surrendering to the dynamic energy of Mahadev brings absolute success.

The ideal time to listen to this high-energy Sawan Song is during the early morning hours or during evening twilight prayers. Let the sacred rhythms elevate your spirit and deepen your devotion.

Har Har Mahadev!

बम बम भोले!
बोल बम!

वीडियो अच्छा लगे तो इसे Like करें और अपने सभी कांवड़िया एवं शिवभक्त मित्रों के साथ Share जरूर करें।

snippet.title: స్వామియే శరణం అయ్యప్ప 🙏 | Ayyappa Swamy Charitra | Ayyappa Folk Songs Full Telugu
snippet.description:
స్వామియే శరణం అయ్యప్ప 🙏 | Ayyappa Swamy Charitra | Ayyappa Folk Songs Full Telugu

Telangana Folk Songs
Lyrics  : Maddiveni Srinivas 

Listen to the divine story and powerful folk devotional songs of Lord Ayyappa in Telugu. “Swamiye Saranam Ayyappa” is a sacred chant that fills the heart with devotion, courage, peace, and positive energy.

This devotional collection includes Ayyappa Swamy Charitra, traditional Telugu folk songs, Sabarimala bhakti songs, and Manikanta devotional melodies. These songs are ideal for morning prayers, evening worship, Mandala Deeksha, pooja time, and peaceful spiritual listening.

May Lord Ayyappa bless every devotee with strength, wisdom, happiness, and inner peace.

snippet.title: 🌿കർക്കിടകം 20-ാം ദിവസം പാരായണം ചെയ്യേണ്ട അദ്ധ്യാത്മരാമായണം | Yudhakandam 02 | Ramayanam Malayalam
snippet.description:
🌿🙏 കർക്കിടകം 20-ാം ദിവസം പാരായണം ചെയ്യേണ്ട അദ്ധ്യാത്മരാമായണം | യുദ്ധകാണ്ഡം 02

കർക്കിടക മാസത്തിലെ 20-ാം ദിവസം ഭക്തിപൂർവ്വം പാരായണം ചെയ്യേണ്ട അദ്ധ്യാത്മരാമായണത്തിലെ യുദ്ധകാണ്ഡം 02 ഇതാ സമർപ്പിക്കുന്നു. ശ്രീരാമഭഗവാന്റെ ധർമ്മവിജയവും ഭക്തിയുടെ മഹിമയും പ്രതിഫലിപ്പിക്കുന്ന ഈ യുദ്ധകാണ്ഡം പാരായണം ചെയ്യുന്നത് മനസ്സിന് സമാധാനവും ആത്മീയ ശക്തിയും നൽകുമെന്ന് വിശ്വസിക്കപ്പെടുന്നു.

ഈ രാമായണമാസത്തിൽ കുടുംബാംഗങ്ങളോടൊപ്പം ദിനവും അദ്ധ്യാത്മരാമായണം യുദ്ധകാണ്ഡം പാരായണം ചെയ്ത് ശ്രീരാമന്റെ അനുഗ്രഹം പ്രാപിക്കൂ.

🙏 വീഡിയോ ഇഷ്ടമായാൽ Like 👍 ചെയ്യുക, Share 📲 ചെയ്യുക, കൂടുതൽ ഭക്തിഗാനങ്ങൾക്കും രാമായണ പാരായണങ്ങൾക്കും Sargam Musics Bhakthiganangal ചാനൽ Subscribe 🔔 ചെയ്യാൻ മറക്കരുതേ.

🌿🙏 Adhyathma Ramayanam – Yudhakandam 02 | Karkidakam Day 20 Ramayanam Parayanam

Listen to and recite Adhyathma Ramayanam Yudhakandam 02, the chapter traditionally read on the 20th day of the holy Malayalam month of Karkidakam (Ramayana Masam). Yudhakandam narrates Lord Rama's righteous battle against Ravana, symbolizing the victory of dharma over evil and inspiring devotion, courage, and faith.

May the daily recitation of Adhyathma Ramayanam Yudhakandam bring peace, prosperity, divine blessings, and spiritual strength to you and your family during this sacred Ramayana month.

🙏 If you enjoy this devotional recitation, please Like, Share, and Subscribe to Sargam Musics Bhakthiganangal for more Malayalam devotional songs and Ramayanam Parayanam.
